unmatched.title: Login returns early for unknown email without hashing, enabling timing-based user enumeration
jwt.verify does not pin allowed algorithms (and sign does not set one explicitly)
No security headers plugin (helmet) registered on the app
Custom error handler maps every non-validation error to 500, masking 4xx errors such as malformed JSON or payload too large
Shutdown handler has no try/catch; a failure in app.close() or pool.end() causes an unhandled rejection instead of a non-zero exit
